description: Land Title Settlement Department - Moragollagama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420911 (23/0930)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, land extents, and encumbrances. The content is focused on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
